notes: Patagonia: guarding the ruddy-headed goose is now one of the first projects you can take.
Fixed: in some lands (like East Asia, Australia and Patagonia) the star for planting 3 kinds of tree could never be earned. It now asks for the kinds that land really has.
Fixed: when a trip loops back to your home city, you can now land there. Before, the plane could crash into that runway.
A new plane in the 2030s: the truss-braced wing, and at the top of its line the blended wing!
Two new levels for every part of your plane: smarter forecasts, contrail-aware air traffic control, low-soot fuel, bird detection and more.
Birds and turns: the sky shows you a bird corridor and arrows for turns ahead.
The 2030s crossings are open, 30,000 km long, including the long way from Auckland to Santiago.
NATURE money: level 3 brings bonds. Stats that do not change now say "same".
Starting in a new land now works smoothly: NATURE opens on your own home land and the tree-planting card is there, not in the UK.
The guide now shows you the hangar: tap the engines to see them, take them for free, and watch your plane get better before you take off.
Missions no longer send you to the city you are already in.
Three new places to start your journey: New Zealand's island forest, the Australian bush, and the Patagonian steppe!
Each land has its own trees, animals and projects to discover in NATURE.
Maori names now show properly, with their long vowels (like ā and ē).
Fixed: NATURE now opens on your own home land when you start somewhere far from the UK.
A new plane to build: the 787! Fly it on the long crossing to the next land, 27,000 km away.
The sky gets trickier in the 2010s: gaps in the storms move and drift, and the screen now shows you where they are going.
In the hangar, tap a part to see what it does before you buy. Every buy plays a little show of your plane getting better.
The big lap of the Earth is waiting for you at the very end.
NATURE projects: the first two levels of finance are open.
Early prizes give fewer seeds now, so your seeds come in more slowly and each upgrade feels earned.
Behind the scenes: new tests for the tougher skies of later years.
NATURE has a guided start: claim your prizes, pick a land, tap a project's name to see a preview, and take your first project for FREE.
Tap any nature project to preview it: you see the trees and animals it will bring. When you buy one, it drops into the land.
Fixed: the guide's speech bubble no longer jumps from side to side.
When you pick your first upgrade, the picture zooms in on the new part, and a label tells you what it is.
Fixed: on iPhones, opening the app again could show a "game got stuck" card just because a sound would not start. A sound problem can no longer stop the game.
Fixed: the guided steps no longer get stuck on a short phone. The glowing button always stays on screen, and you can scroll the page behind the dimmed layer.
New: when you pick your first upgrade, your plane shows as it was, then the new part slides on with a sparkle.
Every city now has its own skyline picture, including the new ones like Melbourne, Wellington and Tromso.
Your first tree parcels are FREE! The game tells you where to pick them up.
Lessons never get you stuck: if you miss one twice, the game counts it as taught and moves on.
Tips never get lost or show at the wrong moment, and pop-ups no longer sit on top of each other or cover the plane.
The fly-past lesson tells you to fly PAST the first airport, and the results line says "Landing bonus".
Your first icy-air lesson is easier: the patch is big, sits at your height and is easy to see, with no storms in the way.
After your third landing, Captain Contrail points you to YOUR RECORDS.
The "tap to skip" hint no longer gets cut off on small phones.
Your first hour is now guided, one step at a time, by Captain Contrail (a friendly green planet). After flight school, each step lights up exactly one thing to tap and everything else waits.
Tips in the sky are small strips that never cover your plane.
The first daytime icy patch is easy to see, and if you miss it twice the game moves you on. No more getting stuck.

New: YOUR RECORDS! After your third landing the BOARDS tab appears. It has 4 good records (furthest flight, tree kinds, cool skies, missions) and 4 OOPS records (longest crash, shortest flight, bird magnet, most crashes), for this week and for ever.
Beat your own record and you see NEW RECORD! No confusing points: every record says in one line what it counts.
Ranking against other pilots comes back when online does.
Easier third lesson: dodge one icy patch at night.
If you haven't claimed your prizes, the game reminds you before the tree lesson.
Pop-ups no longer cover the flight text, and the guided tour never freezes your taps.
The bottom menu bar is back on every screen.
Fixed: two lines of flight text drawn on top of each other.
Fixed: your progress could be wiped by a tiny hidden reset button in the corner. The button is gone, and the game can no longer be reset by accident.
Fixed: after flight school you can now always reach the hangar to pick your free upgrade.
New areas start at a fair level: missions there ramp up as you progress in that area.
Missions you have already met tick straight away.
Missions grow with you: every area has three tiers of missions. Any 3 of a tier open the next, and any 2 of the 3 starred ones open the crossing.
Today: the MISSIONS screen shows three small missions that change every day.
Behind the scenes: much faster tests, so new fixes reach you sooner.
Missions for season 2: five first lessons, then each area's missions in three tiers. The 3 starred ones open the next crossing.
Your first free upgrade now leads you into the hangar, with three easy choices at the top.
Flight school flies over your own start area, and new things come one at a time: animals after the nature lesson, tree parcels at lesson 5.
Friendlier tips that stay long enough to read, and new tutorial pictures with your own plane.
Tap an animal in NATURE to see it up close.
Season 2 home screen: one NEXT goal, a big world you can spin, TAKE OFF, and tiles for the hangar and nature.
Much shorter tips that never pause the game. Tap a tip to close it and keep flying.
Behind the scenes: a new plan for season 2 missions.
Season 2 tells you the truth: the pilot names and leaderboards are resting for now, instead of saying there is no internet.
When there is no crossing to fly yet, the FLY screen now says when the next one opens.
The laps count now says it is times round the Earth, wherever you start.
Easier to see where to fly! A clear gate shows the next gap between storms, with an arrow pointing the way. No-fly zones are striped red and white.
NATURE tells you what to do next in each land: the next tree to plant, the next level, and an animal to look out for.
Nature projects now show the animals they bring back.
Flight school starts in your own city, not London.
Behind the scenes: smarter test pilots, and more checks that season 2 works.
Season 2 is here! The world is split into areas. Pick where you start, fly around your area, and earn the right to cross to the next one.
A crossing is one long flight to a new area. It opens when you have flown most of the way there before (70% of its length) and your nature is thriving (biodiversity 30).
Your old game is safe. Season 2 is a fresh start with its own save, and your old progress is kept exactly as you left it.
The first storms are gentler and the sky closes in more slowly, so there is more room to learn.
This season ends after the 1990s crossings. More is coming!
Behind the scenes: every test flight on the same sky now meets the same storms, icy air and birds, however it flies, so we can compare ways of flying fairly.
Soil plots now turn up on schedule whether or not you drop parcels.
Forecast-only icy air (the patches that pop when you get close) no longer decides where later storms can go.
Behind the scenes: test pilots that fly through storm gaps like real players, so we can check how long each part of the game takes.
Behind the scenes: the game's flying rules now also run as a super-fast test flight, so we can check that every plane is fair.
Fixed: Comet engine upgrades now keep their cleaner-air bonus when you buy the next one.
Behind the scenes: the game's flying rules can now be tested super fast, so we can make every plane fair and fun.
A wrong forecast patch of icy air now fades away the same way every time.
Every wild area now has its own tree layout, and trees no longer stand on top of your nature projects.
Mission 8, Make your plane cleaner, can be finished again: buy better engines for your plane in the hangar, then land.
Long city names and land names now fit on the screen, and the tree button says SEND A SEED.
Lisbon's runway is now on land, not out at sea.
Every nature project has a new picture, and when you finish one it appears in that land's wild area: beaver lodges, coral reefs, stork nests, fish ladders and more.
Each wild area now only grows the trees you planted in that land, like acacias in the desert and oaks in the UK.
The tawny owl now flies side-on like the other birds.
Every land has its own biodiversity. Fly into a land to see its name and meter; the results show each land your trees helped.
Lands now have biome names, like Temperate woodland and African savanna. NATURE says where each land's projects come from and how to bring it back to life.
Rewilding brings MUCH more life: a fully rewilded land is packed with trees and animals.
Planting a new kind of tree shows a picture of it.
A real world globe! It turns so your whole trip is in view. Drag it round, or tap a light square to choose that way.
Swipe sideways to move between the tabs in NATURE and in the HANGAR. In NATURE the picture and the biodiversity bar now stay at the top while you scroll.
The game now updates itself when you are on the menu, so you always have the newest version.
Fixed: NATURE no longer gets stuck with an unusual save.
Every wild area has its own field now! Each land on the NATURE screen has its own view, from desert mesas and Mount Kilimanjaro to snowy northern lakes and the rainforest.
Shiny new badges: every medal has a brand new picture, and they are bigger too.
All 48 kinds of tree have new pictures, from baobabs to cherry blossom, in the sky and on their NATURE cards.
Fixed: the new animals you find on a flight now show their new pictures on the results screen too.
The savanna, the Amazon rainforest, the open sea and the ice now have their own landscape below your plane.
Over the sea and the ice there is nothing to plant on, so the DROP button waits until you are over land again.
Every city now has its own skyline! Spot Big Ben, the Eiffel Tower, the pyramids, Mount Fuji and more behind the runway when you land.
New thunderclouds! Storms are now giant towering clouds that crackle with little flashes of lightning inside. Fly through the gap between them!
Your upgrades now show! New engines, gold stripes, glass cockpits and more appear on your plane, in flight and in the hangar.
Gadgets are fitted to your plane: magnets, sensors, antennas and cargo, a new look each era.
Airports show your systems: the control tower grows with air traffic control, and a weather station appears with forecasting.
Fly further: the Earth can take more heat before a flight is grounded, and the 1950s upgrades save more fuel.
New eras open sooner: 20 minutes of flying opens the 1970s.
The hangar shows a big picture of your plane. Tap a plane to see it. NEW! only lights up when something new is ready.
No SAF cans until SAF is invented (the 2010s), and the autopilot pick-up comes once you buy the Autopilot gadget.
Easier to read: more space between lines, bigger small text, and shorter era cards.
The Earth above your heat bar has a new face. As it gets hotter it turns red, starts to sweat, and if it gets too hot, it cries. Keep it cool and keep it smiling!
New pictures for every animal! All 189 wild animals and birds have fresh pixel art, in the sky and on their NATURE cards.

Plane ERAS! Start in the 1950s with the Comet, the first jet airliner. Fly to open the 1970s (747 jumbo) and the 1990s (a big twin). Your plane upgrades start again, with 300 seeds to get going. Seeds, crystals, nature, badges and records are all kept.
A new hangar: choose which plane to fly, and upgrade its engines, wings and cabin. New systems (forecasting, air traffic control, fuel and operations) and gadgets help every flight.
Efficient planes make contrails more easily, right up to the edge of icy air. Old hot jets only make them deep inside. That is real science!
Weather forecasts show icy air sooner, but sometimes they are wrong: a fake patch puffs away when you get close. Air traffic control makes the sky a little kinder.
Passengers pay fares when you land. A fuller plane makes less CO2 per passenger.
Trips between cities are shorter again, with storms closer together and bumpy air sooner, so the sky stays busy.
Playing without internet? Your flights now wait on your device and all go up together when you are back online.
A little "Back online!" message shows while your progress uploads, then "All saved!".
Flights you fly before choosing a pilot name now count once you choose one.
FLY ON now shows the map, so you choose which way to fly next.
Sunsets and sunrises are quicker. The sun sets behind the hills as the moon comes up.
Contrails switch from cooling to warming halfway through sunset, and back at sunrise.
Trips between cities are longer, with more storms to dodge.
Fly anywhere! Over 100 airports round the world. Before each flight, choose one of three ways to go: the globe shows where it leads.
Africa's savanna and the Amazon rainforest are now on the map. Fly over a new land to discover it: its NATURE tab opens.
Trees you drop are that land's own trees: olives, baobabs, kapok and more (some pictures are still being drawn).
Instead of laps, see how many times round the Earth you have flown. New mission: the World tour!
Fixed: the game froze when you flew out over the sea.
If anything ever goes wrong, the game now shows what happened and a RESTART button, instead of freezing.
The land below you now changes as you fly round the world: woodland, Mediterranean, desert and more.
Animals on the ground and in the air change with the land too.
The game now tells you when a new version is ready. Tap UPDATE on the menu: your progress is kept.
AUTOPILOT badges fly your plane perfectly for 8 seconds: nothing can crash you!
Grab the green SAF can for cleaner fuel: less CO2 and thinner contrails.
A forest meter at the bottom grows as your trees soak up CO2. Plant early!
Sunset and sunrise are slower, and a little dial under the distance shows when night is coming.
No more soil patches once your parcels are gone.
